info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector SolutionSelfHelp API
Microsoft Azure Get Providers Microsoft Help Selfhelp Solutionid

params.name: solutionId
params.description: SolutionId is a unique id to identify a solution. You can retrieve the solution id using the Discovery api - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/help/discovery-solution/list?view=rest-help-2023-09-01-preview&tabs=HTTP

items.docs: Gets Self Help Solutions for a given solutionId. Self Help Solutions consist of rich instructional video tutorials, links and guides to public documentation related to a specific problem that enables users to troubleshoot Azure issues.
